dialogue.origin: こんばんは、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for being here.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: もう始まってもだいじょうぶです
dialogue.content: It's alright to begin now.

dialogue.origin: 有難うございますお言葉に甘えて始めさせていただきますね
dialogue.content: Thank you. I'll take you up on that and we'll begin.

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員ですよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm your counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくおねがいします
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 主人と別れたいんです
dialogue.content: I want to leave my husband.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねよろしければどんなことがあったかお聞かせいただけますか
dialogue.content: I see. If you're comfortable, could you tell me more about what's happened?

dialogue.origin: 主人はわがままな人で
dialogue.content: My husband is a selfish person.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 趣味というか、仕事以外にいくつかサークルみたいなことに参加していて
dialogue.content: Well, it's his hobbies... outside of work, he's involved in several club-like activities.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 結婚してからずっと土日はサークル、平日は仕事で夫婦でいる意味がないと思うんです
dialogue.content: Ever since we got married, his weekends are for his clubs and weekdays are for work. I feel like there's no point in us being a married couple.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それはとても寂しいですよね、、
dialogue.content: I see, that must be very lonely for you...

dialogue.origin: 明日はサッカーの試合だから、サッカー用の靴下出しておいて
dialogue.content: He'll say things like, 'I have a soccer game tomorrow, so get my soccer socks ready.'

dialogue.origin: みたいな感じで
dialogue.content: Things like that.

dialogue.origin: 釣りだから、みそ汁を持たせてくれとか
dialogue.content: Or, 'I'm going fishing, so pack me some miso soup.'

dialogue.origin: よほどの予定でない限りはいろいろな外出をしていて
dialogue.content: Unless there’s something truly unavoidable, he’s always going out for one thing or another.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 私も行けばそれなりにお友達の奥様とかもいて、参加できると言えばそうなんですけど
dialogue.content: If I go with him, some of his friends' wives are there, so I suppose I could participate.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 興味のない寒い海などで
dialogue.content: But it's at a cold beach I have no interest in, and things like that.

dialogue.origin: ええーそれはひどい、、
dialogue.content: Oh, that's awful...

dialogue.origin: 結局一日少しは気を使って過ごすしかなくて
dialogue.content: In the end, I just have to spend the whole day being a bit on edge and minding my manners.

dialogue.origin: だったらうちにいるってなることが多くて
dialogue.content: So, I often end up staying home instead.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうなるのも無理ないですよね、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, it's completely understandable that you'd feel that way...

dialogue.origin: 夫婦でいる意味あるのかなって
dialogue.content: I wonder if there's any point in us being a couple.

dialogue.origin: 人生やり直したいって
dialogue.content: I want to start my life over.

dialogue.origin: 思ってるんです
dialogue.content: That’s what I’m thinking.

dialogue.origin: 本当にそうですよね何のために、夫婦でいるのかって思ってしまいまよね、、
dialogue.content: I can really understand that. It makes you wonder what the purpose of being married is, doesn't it...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そして、人生をやり直したいとまで悩んでおられるのですね、、
dialogue.content: And you're even contemplating starting your life over...

dialogue.origin: こんなふうに扱われたら嫌になってしまいますよね、、
dialogue.content: Being treated like that would make anyone fed up...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今はまだ30代なので
dialogue.content: I’m still in my 30s now.

dialogue.origin: やり直すならいまかなって
dialogue.content: So, if I'm going to start over, now might be the time.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、これからのことを考えると今かなと思われるのですね
dialogue.content: Mm-hm, thinking about the future, it seems like now might be the time.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今ご結婚されて何年目くらいでしょうか
dialogue.content: How many years have you been married?

dialogue.origin: 6年になります
dialogue.content: It's been six years.

dialogue.origin: 6年もそんな生活に耐えて頑張ってこられたのですね、、
dialogue.content: You've endured such a life for six years... you've been trying so hard.

dialogue.origin: 結婚して2年くらいは
dialogue.content: For the first two years or so of our marriage...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 私も参加したり、主人も遠慮して私との時間をとってくれたりしていたんですが
dialogue.content: I would participate in things, and my husband would also be considerate and make time for me.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 3年前くらいからは自分のペースで
dialogue.content: But from about three years ago, he started doing things at his own pace.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: これからスキーに行ってくるとか言って2泊くらい勝手にお友達と
dialogue.content: He'd say things like, 'I'm going skiing now,' and just take off with his friends for a couple of nights without asking.

dialogue.origin: 言ってしまったち
dialogue.content: Just announcing it,

dialogue.origin: 行ってしまったりでした
dialogue.content: and then just going.

dialogue.origin: ええっ！そんな・・・2日も勝手に・・
dialogue.content: What?! He just... took off for two days on his own...?

dialogue.origin: とても寂しいですよね、、
dialogue.content: That must be so lonely...

dialogue.origin: 良くあるんです
dialogue.content: It happens often.

dialogue.origin: 心を広くして、許してこられたのですね、、
dialogue.content: You've been so broad-minded and forgiving of him...

dialogue.origin: 許すというか・・・
dialogue.content: It's not so much forgiving as...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 何かのタイミングで変わってくれることがあるかもと
dialogue.content: I was hoping that at some point, he might change.

dialogue.origin: このところのコロナで
dialogue.content: With the recent COVID situation,

dialogue.origin: うんうんそんな期待も持っていたのですね
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, you were holding onto that hope.

dialogue.origin: どうぞコロナで・・
dialogue.content: Please, go on about COVID...

dialogue.origin: 外出が制限されても結局、海なら三密じゃないとか
dialogue.content: Even with restrictions on going out, he’d say things like, ‘The beach doesn’t involve the “Three Cs,”’

dialogue.origin: ツーリングなら一人一人だとか
dialogue.content: or, 'If we're motorcycle touring, we're all separate.'

dialogue.origin: そんな理由で、、こっちは我慢ならないですよね、、
dialogue.content: Using those kinds of excuses... that must be unbearable for you...

dialogue.origin: やっぱり出かけていくので、
dialogue.content: He just goes out anyway.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: たまには家にいたらって
dialogue.content: I’d tell him, ‘How about staying home once in a while?’

dialogue.origin: 言っても
dialogue.content: Even when I say that,

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 何かやることあるの？って
dialogue.content: he says, ‘Is there anything to do?’

dialogue.origin: ええっ！そんな・・
dialogue.content: What?! He says that...?

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 一緒の時間を大事にしたいですよね、、
dialogue.content: You just want to cherish your time together, don't you...

dialogue.origin: 一緒にいたいとかも
dialogue.content: Even when I say I want to be with him,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: じゃあついてくればみんな喜ぶよ
dialogue.content: He says, 'Then just come along, everyone would be happy to have you.'

dialogue.origin: って
dialogue.content: That's what he says.

dialogue.origin: みんなじゃないのに
dialogue.content: But it's not 'everyone' for me.

dialogue.origin: 私にとっては他人の集まりだし
dialogue.content: To me, it’s just a gathering of strangers.

dialogue.origin: こんなに理解してもらえないなら
dialogue.content: If he can't understand me this much...

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうですよねそんなところに行っても楽しくもないですよね、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, that's right. It wouldn't be any fun to go to a place like that...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: No, it wouldn't.

dialogue.origin: はい、どうぞ
dialogue.content: Yes, please continue.

dialogue.origin: 一緒にいる意味が無いなって
dialogue.content: I feel like there's no point in us being together.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、それはそう考えるのはもっともだと思います
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, I think it's perfectly reasonable for you to think that way.

dialogue.origin: これからどうしたらいいでしょう
dialogue.content: What should I do from now on?

dialogue.origin: それをこれから一緒に考えていきましょう
dialogue.content: Let's think about that together.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんが留守の間は、どうされていますか
dialogue.content: What do you usually do when your husband is away?

dialogue.origin: サブスクの映画を観たり
dialogue.content: I watch movies on streaming services...

dialogue.origin: 結局寝ちゃったり
dialogue.content: Or I just end up falling asleep.

dialogue.origin: 今はコロナでお友達と会うのも遠慮してるので
dialogue.content: Right now, I'm also refraining from meeting up with friends because of COVID.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 一人で日帰り温泉に行ったりしちゃいます
dialogue.content: Sometimes I'll go to a day-trip hot spring by myself.

dialogue.origin: 一人だとやることがあまりないですよね、、コロナもありますし、、でも温泉は楽しまれたのですね
dialogue.content: There isn't much to do when you're alone, especially with COVID... But it's good you were able to enjoy the hot spring.

dialogue.origin: 実家が近いので
dialogue.content: My parents' house is nearby.

dialogue.origin: 実家でゴロゴロしたり
dialogue.content: So sometimes I just lounge around there.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: だから、独身の人と変わらないです
dialogue.content: So, it's really no different from being single.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、、一人だなと感じますよね、、
dialogue.content: Right... you must feel so alone...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: やり直すなら
dialogue.content: If I’m going to start over,

dialogue.origin: こどもができる前に
dialogue.content: it has to be before we have children.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 決断しないと
dialogue.content: I need to make a decision,

dialogue.origin: っていうのが今年なんです
dialogue.content: and this is the year for that.

dialogue.origin: 33才になるので
dialogue.content: I'm turning 33.

dialogue.origin: こどもが欲しいってことも考えて次のパートナーとかいる未来を考えると
dialogue.content: Thinking about wanting children and a future with a new partner...

dialogue.origin: うんうん本当に今ですよね
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, it really is the time, isn't it.

dialogue.origin: ぎりぎりって
dialogue.content: I feel like this is my last chance.

dialogue.origin: 思うんです
dialogue.content: That's what I think.

dialogue.origin: もうここが限界ですよね、、
dialogue.content: You've reached your limit, haven't you...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんは、結婚する以前はどんな感じだったのでしょうか？やはり趣味に熱中するタイプだったのでしょうか
dialogue.content: What was your husband like before you got married? Was he always the type to be passionate about his hobbies?

dialogue.origin: そうでした
dialogue.content: He was.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: いろんな集まりで元気よく活発にしているのが
dialogue.content: The way he was so energetic and active at all sorts of gatherings...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 頼りになる感じに見えたのですが
dialogue.content: it seemed like he was a dependable person.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 家庭を顧みないほど
dialogue.content: But to the point of neglecting our family...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 活動を続けるとは思っていなかったし、今子供を持っても彼はきっと私の負担とか考えないなって
dialogue.content: I never thought he would continue his activities this much, and I feel that even if we had a child now, he surely wouldn't consider the burden on me.

dialogue.origin: 今の様子を考えると、そう思ってしまうのは無理もないですよね、、
dialogue.content: Considering how things are now, it's completely understandable that you'd think that...

dialogue.origin: こんなはずじゃなかったと、とても悔しいですよね、、
dialogue.content: It must be so frustrating to feel that this isn't how things were supposed to be...

dialogue.origin: はい、外ではハキハキ明るいお兄ちゃんみたいな人ですが、
dialogue.content: Yes, when he's out, he's like a cheerful, articulate older brother type, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それをするための実生活はすかすかです
dialogue.content: the actual home life that supports that persona is completely empty.

dialogue.origin: うんうん愛想をつかしてしますよね、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, it's natural that you would lose your affection for him...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ここまでのお話を少し整理させていただいてよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.content: Would it be all right if I took a moment to summarize what you've shared so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんは仕事以外でも趣味のサークルなどで外出することが多く、ほとんど家におられません
dialogue.content: Your husband is often out for his hobby circles and other activities outside of work, and is rarely at home.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そんな生活を続けて、変わってくれと思っていたがもう無理かもしれないと思っておられます
dialogue.content: You've continued with this lifestyle, hoping he would change, but now you're feeling that it might be impossible.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 子どものことを考えると、これから未来の人とのことを考えると今がその時ではないかと思っておられます
dialogue.content: Considering the possibility of having children and a future with someone else, you feel that now is the time to make a decision.

dialogue.origin: このようなお話と思いますが、いかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: Is that an accurate summary?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: ご自身がこの場で一番解決したいと思うのはどういったところでしょうか
dialogue.content: What is the one thing you'd most like to resolve here today?

dialogue.origin: 主人にどう切り出して話し合おうかということです
dialogue.content: It's about how to bring this up and discuss it with my husband.

dialogue.origin: 彼には理解できないと思います
dialogue.content: I don’t think he’ll understand.

dialogue.origin: うんうん夫さんはびっくりするかもしれないと感じておられるのですね
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, so you feel that your husband might be very surprised.

dialogue.origin: 錯乱したりしたら
dialogue.content: If he gets agitated or unhinged,

dialogue.origin: やだなと
dialogue.content: I don't want to deal with that.

dialogue.origin: うんうん　もしもそうなったら怖いですよね
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, it would be frightening if that were to happen.

dialogue.origin: そんなことがこれまでにもあったのでしょうか
dialogue.content: Has anything like that happened before?

dialogue.origin: 何か話しても「はいはい分かった、俺が悪いんでしょ」みたいに
dialogue.content: Whenever I try to talk to him about something, he says things like, 'Yeah, yeah, I get it. It's all my fault, right?'

dialogue.origin: 深く聞いて話し合う事の出来ない人なので
dialogue.content: He's not the type of person who can listen deeply and have a real discussion.

dialogue.origin: 「別れる必要ないじゃん、いえにいるようにするからさ」みたいに
dialogue.content: He'll probably just say something like, 'There's no need to separate. I'll start staying home more.'

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それは困りますよね、、
dialogue.content: I see. That would be very difficult...

dialogue.origin: いっそ、実家に帰ってしまおうかと思ってます
dialogue.content: I'm thinking I might as well just go back to my parents' house.

dialogue.origin: 私さえ離婚の気持ちがしっかりしてれば
dialogue.content: As long as I'm firm in my decision to divorce...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: お金の話はあとで
dialogue.content: The money talk can come later.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: まずは自分の気持ちを伝えて分かってもらいたいですよね、、
dialogue.content: First and foremost, you want to convey your feelings and have him understand, don't you...

dialogue.origin: ここまでお話を聞かせていただいてですが
dialogue.content: Based on what you've told me so far,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご自身は、夫さんが平気で家を留守にするようなひどい行動にずっと耐えてこられたとても我慢強い方だと思いましたし、とても心の広い方だと感じました
dialogue.content: I think you're a very patient and broad-minded person for enduring your husband's inconsiderate absences for so long.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: でも、夫さんはその優しくて広い心に甘えて、ずっと自分の行動を変えようとはしてきませんでしたし、これからもおそらく変わらないかもしれません
dialogue.content: However, your husband has taken advantage of that kind and broad-minded nature, has never tried to change his behavior, and will likely not change in the future.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: であれば、ご自身のお気持をちゃんと伝える時だと私も思います
dialogue.content: If that's the case, I also believe it's time to properly communicate your feelings.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: でも聞いてくれないので
dialogue.content: But he won’t listen.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: はぐらかされるだけだろうと感じるのですね
dialogue.content: You feel that he will just brush it off.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そこでご提案なのですが、ご自身のお気持を手紙にしたためて、夫さんに渡すというのはいかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: In that case, I have a suggestion. How about writing your feelings down in a letter and giving it to your husband?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's a good idea.

dialogue.origin: 手紙を置いて、数日家から出ようかなと今思いました
dialogue.content: I just thought that maybe I could leave the letter and leave the house for a few days.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんも状況を理解すると思います
dialogue.content: I think your husband will understand the situation then.

dialogue.origin: そうしてみます！
dialogue.content: I’ll try that!

dialogue.origin: ええ是非実行していただければよいかと思います
dialogue.content: Yes, I think it would be a very good idea to put that into action.

dialogue.origin: はい！なんかすっきりしました！
dialogue.content: Yes! I feel so much clearer now!

dialogue.origin: はい、是非そうして話を前に進めてみてくださいご自身の明るい未来のために！
dialogue.content: Yes, please do that to move things forward. For your own bright future!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you very much!

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、大切なお話をしてくださりありがとうございます！
dialogue.content: Thank you as well for sharing such an important story with me.

dialogue.origin: やってみます！
dialogue.content: I'll do it!

dialogue.origin: はいご自身がイキイキと自分らしく生きていくことを心から応援しております！
dialogue.content: Yes, I wholeheartedly support you in living a vibrant life that's true to yourself!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうござインす！
dialogue.content: Thank you!

dialogue.origin: ございます！
dialogue.content: Thank you!

dialogue.origin: それでは本日の相談終了したいと思います
dialogue.content: Well then, I would like to conclude today's session.

dialogue.origin: はい、失礼します
dialogue.content: Okay, goodbye.

dialogue.origin: 有難うございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you very much!

dialogue.origin: 失礼いたします
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: （お疲れさまでしたー）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your hard work.)

dialogue.origin: （またご一緒するときありましたらどうぞよろしくお願いします　それでは失礼いたします）
dialogue.content: (If we have another opportunity to work together, I look forward to it. With that, goodbye.)

topic.sub: 夫とのコミュニケーション問題
